title: Nudge escalation ladder (documentation entry)
description: The parity-ledger proof that the palette covers the nudge law: after a waiting assignment goes quiet, wait one interval, nudge once, wait a second interval, escalate to the owner. Stays disabled until the optional sweeper consolidation; it exercises only the timer + escalate palette.
